function extractBookId(input) {
    if (!input) return '';
    var s = String(input);
    if (/^\d{15,20}$/.test(s)) return s;
    var m = s.match(/data:;base64,([^,]+)/i);
    if (m) {
        try {
            var decoded = java.base64Decode(m[1]);
            if (decoded && /^\d{15,20}$/.test(decoded)) return decoded;
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    try {
        var decoded = java.hexDecodeToString(s);
        if (decoded && /^\d{15,20}$/.test(decoded)) return decoded;
    } catch(e) {}
    if (s.indexOf(',') >= 0) {
        var first = s.split(',')[0];
        if (/^\d{15,20}$/.test(first)) return first;
        try {
            var d = java.base64Decode(first);
            if (d && /^\d{15,20}$/.test(d)) return d;
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    var match = s.match(/\d{15,20}/);
    if (match) return match[0];
    return s;
}
